name: ccm-bc500-export
description: CCM bC500 employee export from benefitsCONNECT System Administration. Port of workflows/ccm/bc-census-export/benefitsconnect-employee-export.py (Otto session 973614649571). Logs in, selects the company, exports record type 500 for the configured date range, converts tab-delimited to CSV in-page, and writes the file to a deterministic path for acquisition.local-file pickup. outputs.file_path = the written CSV.

COMPANY_NAME.description: Exact company name as shown in the bC company list

OUTPUT_DIR.description: Directory the converted CSV is written into (acquisition seam root)

RUN_DATE.description: Date stamp for the output filename, e.g. 2026-08-07

steps.name: Open System Administration login in a new tab
Click Login
steps.selector: #DocContent > table > tbody > tr:nth-of-type(2) > td:nth-of-type(3) > div > a

steps.name: Handle 'already logged in' interstitial if present
Expand Company Management menu
steps.value: document.querySelector('#DocContent > table > tbody > tr > td:nth-of-type(1) > a').click();

steps.name: Select company by exact name
Expand Company Administration menu
steps.value: document.querySelector('#DocContent > table > tbody > tr > td:nth-of-type(1) > a').click();

steps.name: Set export date span
Click Process to generate the export
Fetch export and convert tab-delimited to CSV in-page
Write CSV to acquisition seam path
